title: Article 144 — Civil and judicial authorities to act in aid of the Supreme Court

content.overview: Article 144 provides that all authorities, civil and judicial, in the territory of India shall act in aid of the Supreme Court.
content.glance: All civil and judicial authorities in India shall act in aid of the Supreme Court.
content.study:
Article 144 imposes a constitutional duty on all civil and judicial authorities throughout India to act in aid of the Supreme Court. It supports the effectiveness of SC decrees, orders and processes.

Examination: duty on all civil and judicial authorities; nationwide; aids enforcement and respect for SC processes.

sections.heading: Key rule
sections.body: All authorities, civil and judicial, in the territory of India shall act in aid of the Supreme Court.
